claim_one_line: L126 -- ONE Z/2 OR TWO? OUTCOME INDEPENDENT against a criterion sealed and pushed (57be2252, sha-256 48732158...) BEFORE any cell ran, with the prior declared SPLIT and the convenient answer named in advance as the one that must clear the higher bar. IT DID NOT CLEAR IT. On cyclic LR-words let rho = word reversal (reversing the base S^1 = TIME reversal of the suspension flow) and sigma = R<->L swap (fiber orientation flip = CHIRALITY); they generate a Klein group V, and GHH's criterion (B136) says amphichiral <=> the PRODUCT rho.sigma fixes the word. CELL 1: for the object W = RL, cyclic rotations {RL, LR}, BOTH rho and sigma send RL to LR, which IS a rotation -- so Stab_V(RL) = the FULL Klein group {1, rho, sigma, rho.sigma}. The two involutions are INDEPENDENT symmetries of m004. CELL 2 rules out the degeneracy the prereg flagged in advance: EVERY metallic word R^m L^m for m = 1..8 has the full Klein stabilizer, so this is not an artifact of the shortest word -- THE WHOLE METALLIC LOCUS DECOUPLES THE TWO INVOLUTIONS. CELL 3, THE CENSUS, AND THE FINDING WORTH MORE THAN THE VERDICT: over all 241 cyclic classes of length <= 10 containing both letters, the stabilizer distribution is full-V 13, diagonal-only {1, rho.sigma} 18, {1, rho} 122, trivial 88 -- so of the 31 AMPHICHIRAL classes, 18 sit in the LOCKED class (fixed by the product but by NEITHER involution alone) against 13 with the full group. THE LOCKING IS REAL AND IS THE MAJORITY BEHAVIOUR AMONG AMPHICHIRAL BUNDLES (18/31, about 58%) -- AND OUR OBJECT IS IN THE MINORITY THAT ESCAPES IT. CELL 4: R^T = L, so rho = sigma composed with transpose (verified: reverse(W) = swap(W)^T exactly), hence GHH reads as 'amphichiral <=> W conjugate to W^T', and W = RL = [[2,1],[1,1]] is symmetric on the nose -- BUT THE VACUITY CHECK DEFUSES IT: every matrix is conjugate to its transpose over a field, so the criterion carries NO content at the level of Q and whatever content it has must be INTEGRAL (GL(2,Z)-conjugacy), and no depth is claimed for the symmetry of W. CONSEQUENCE, WITHDRAWN: B944 section 3's suggestion that TIME and CHIRALITY are one unbroken Z/2 for this object, and its corollary that one closing supplies both. A closing that chiralizes the object (B432: all 31 sampled Dehn fillings do) does NOT thereby supply a time arrow; the three named gaps do NOT collapse to one choice; B717's spine stands unamended with TIME and CHIRALITY as two separate closings. L126 CLOSED, NEGATIVE. KEPT AND NEWLY REGISTERED (L129): the LOCKED class exists and is generic, making 'which class does a bundle sit in' a real structural question with a clean combinatorial answer, and placing m004 with the whole metallic locus on the exceptional side. METHOD NOTE: the census that carries the actual discovery exists ONLY because the prereg named the m004-degeneracy worry in advance and pre-committed cells 2-3; added after seeing cell 1 they would have been unfalsifiable follow-up rather than sealed content. LIMITS: length <= 10 (finite sample, no asymptotic claim); word level, not Isom(m004) directly -- a word-level stabilizer realizes bundle symmetries but the converse is not established here; the geometric identifications are the standard fibered-3-manifold readings, used not re-derived.
